authority.scope: Validate the public GTK2 preview route and its current translated controls; do not install to the user session.

test.implementation: Real Theme Lab backend, generator, GTK2 2.24.33 preview process, input events, capture, and pixel verifier; isolated bwrap/Xvfb fixture; no mocks.
test.routes: Public separate native-preview route only. No claim for the embedded/coupled Theme Lab canvas.

historical_pixel_comparison.reference: Retained Domain/OS SR10.4 HP VUE 2.01 Trash Can normal-state PNGs.
historical_pixel_comparison.method: RGB crop comparison at 1:1; 15x15 pixels per stepper, no resizing or interpolation.
historical_pixel_comparison.scope: The DomainOS public preview screenshot matches all four retained normal arrow cells. This does not compare historical pressed states.

limits: GTK2 preview remains partial and recipe scope is limited to translated_controls; this test is not approval of all theme settings.
The embedded/coupled GTK2 preview route remains unverified.
Historical held-state comparisons for left, right and up remain pending until the project VM visibly shows the guest pointer on each target.
Remaining GTK2 control-state audit and user visual review remain open.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: Adds public isolated separate-route evidence for scrollbar input/press/release in two palettes, historical pixel equality for all four normal arrows in that route, and native metrics/interactions for all 16 translated controls. Coupled preview, remaining historical pressed-state comparisons, full audit and human review remain open. Not a visual-fidelity score.
